submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve image edit. EDIT IMAGE 1 into one new, independent full-body game animation pose on the EXACT SAME full transparent canvas. Image1 is the action frame to edit and the authoritative camera/scale/registration target. Image2 is the original identity portrait; Image3 is directional idle for identity and facing only (do not adopt its layout); Image4 is the MAIN STYLE reference for clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand painting, warm gold and fine fabric finish (no UI/background).
The first image's subject design, physical body proportions, head size, fixed camera and canvas dimensions MUST stay unchanged. Do not recompose or recenter the character. Keep the two shoes at precisely their original canvas coordinates. The ground contact line, canvas margins, shoe sizes and leg separation are locked. Change the pose through shoulder/elbow/hip/knee articulations, not whole-image scaling or translation. Keep both shoes resting on the exact same original virtual floor. Preserve transparent alpha and clean silhouette.
Identity: the same chestnut high ponytail boy with red gemstone gold crown, red/gold flame short robe, ivory cuffs, black trousers, red-black-gold shoes, right hand FIVE red talismans, left hand bronze bell and red tassel. FIVE talisman upper edges must be individually countable, all cards firmly held as one fan. No hand switching. Hands must actually grip objects with clear natural chibi fingers.
Targeted correction: HIT/E frame02 of06. Preserve the source's TRUE RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE with nose RIGHT and ONLY ONE VISIBLE EYE; do not turn face toward viewer or show a far second eye. Preserve ALL FIVE source red talisman cards, five separate countable top edges; no missing/merged fourth/fifth card. Near RIGHT shoulder/sleeve connects directly to RIGHT hand gripping fan in front chest; FAR LEFT arm/hand keeps bronze bell behind left waist. Pose is a lesser impact recoil than source: torso still bends LEFT but about half as strongly, visible eye narrows halfway (not winking), brow contracts, jaw tight. Head tilts backward only slightly, knees begin cushioning with original planted stance. Bell arm tenses inward and card arm protects chest without hiding any card top. Maintain source skull size, same camera, shoe positions and full canvas; distinct smaller reaction before frame03's extreme.
Preserve the identity and highest painted finish. Entire figure and props in frame, one character, one pose, native square at least1024. Absolutely no ground shadows, backdrop, checkerboard, labels, writing, fire, loose particles, trails, afterimages, floating cards, extra limbs or duplicate characters. This is a new independently redrawn body pose, not a copied frame, mirrored frame, digitally warped sprite or collage.
